Free tools

Free Cycling Training Tools

Free calculators from Head Coach Matteo Cigala to help you train and race smarter: training zones, fuelling, hydration, Critical Power, climb times and swim pace.

Training Zones Calculator

Your 7 power zones from FTP or a 20-minute test, plus heart-rate zones from your threshold heart rate.

Open the calculator →

Carbs per Hour Calculator

How many grams of carbs to take each hour, and what that means in gels and bottles, for your ride.

Open the calculator →

Critical Power & W′ Calculator

Your Critical Power and W′ from two all-out efforts, and the power you can hold from 2 to 20 minutes.

Open the calculator →

Climb Time Calculator

How long a famous climb, or your own, will take at your power and weight, and the power you need for a target time.

Open the calculator →

Sweat Rate Calculator

Weigh yourself before and after a ride to find how much you sweat, and how much to drink per hour.

Open the calculator →

Swim Pace (CSS) Calculator

For triathletes: your Critical Swim Speed from a 400 m and a 200 m time trial, and your training paces.

Open the calculator →
